description: Three storey side extension to create new dwelling with private amenity space and associated landscaping; Cycle and refuse storage
decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-size:10.5pt"><span pt="" sans=""><span style="color:#333333">The proposed development, by reason of the narrow plot width fails to meet the Nationally Described Space Standards (2015) for living spaces and double bedrooms contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), policy D6 of the London Plan (2021) and Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</span></span></span></p>

<p><span data-teams="true">The development as a 2-bedroom, 3-person dwelling, would fail to provide the minimum four bed spaces required for a 2-bedroom unit under Policy HO1(2) of the Local Plan. The proposal would therefore fail to provide suitably sized and flexible residential accommodation capable of meeting the changing needs of occupants and would undermine the objectives of preventing overcrowding and securing high-quality housing. The development is therefore contrary to Policy HO1(2) of the Local Plan (2021 - 2041) and is unacceptable in principle.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm">The proposed extension by virtue
of its narrow width would unbalance the proportions of the existing terrace of
dwellings, and by extension would have a detrimental impact on the wider
streetscene. As such, the development is contrary to Policy D3 of the London
Plan (2021) and Policies GR1 and GR10 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041)<o:p></o:p></p>
